title: Human inbox reports nothing to review while critical incidents are open

summary.route: management_read_models/router.py passes timeout_seconds = human_inbox_surface_timeout_seconds() + 1.5 s and a completed_contributors dict; on exception it maps ManagementReadTimeout->read_timeout, ManagementReadSaturated->read_capacity_saturated, other->read_error (warning log naming exception type) and composes completed contributors into a partial payload (_get_human_inbox_degraded_payload).
summary.service: ManagementService.get_human_inbox runs approval_queue, governance_review_queue, incidents and persona_readiness concurrently on _HUMAN_INBOX_CONTRIBUTOR_EXECUTOR and composes through compose_human_inbox -> _human_inbox_project_items (canonical projection). Inline item builders deleted. Warm-up loop no longer includes list_incidents.
summary.port: DomainIncidentPort/Composite list_incidents gained open_only (owner ?open_only=true) and raise_on_error (default False keeps swallow-to-[]). Extra kwargs are forwarded only when set, so every other caller's call is unchanged.
summary.projection: governance/human_inbox.py: incident title from title, summary from evidence_summary, priority from severity, no approve/reject actions; proposed approval -> pending; EvolutionDecision review with neither canApprove nor canReject omitted; review/approval deduped (review-<decision_id>); created_at never filled with request time (details.submitted_at honoured); zero-row success is ok; NL path records per-contributor failures instead of raising.

mechanism_remaining.timeout_definition: services/control-plane/bff/governance/service.py human_inbox_surface_timeout_seconds (only one; the 3.0 s copy in governance/human_inbox.py and PANTHEON_BFF_HUMAN_INBOX_TIMEOUT_SECONDS are deleted)
mechanism_remaining.kept: _HUMAN_INBOX_CONTRIBUTOR_EXECUTOR now lives in management_read_models/service.py and is the one contributor mechanism; _HUMAN_INBOX_READ_SLOTS/_EXECUTOR still bound persona_readiness (existing capacity test unchanged).
